world.name: Broken Causeway
world.blurb: Broken Causeway: one continuous road with 13 checkpointed challenges, ending in a superroom.
world.outro: The causeway, end to end. The weight that hung over the road is lying on the Brute.

keepsake.name: Silas’s Winding Key
keepsake.gives: The key in Silas’s back stops turning, and he sits on the patrol walk’s bench because he chose to. In the Fractured Causeway it opens Silas’s echo.

rooms.name: Chainwake Camp
rooms.hint: A lift runs only while weight is on it, then it comes home
rooms.question: The causeway’s lifts hang still. What would set one moving?

people.line: Not one of the yard’s, are you? Nothing up there’s moved in a month.
Hear that? Nothing. The Drop Yard lift is free. Stand on it.

rooms.name: The Hoist
rooms.hint: Jump as a lift stops and you keep its speed
rooms.question: The lift stops well short of the shelf. When do you leave it?

people.line: She comes back down on her own. Ride her up.

rooms.name: The Patrol Road
rooms.hint: A lift throws you the way it was going
rooms.question: The road ends in open air. How far does a flat lift throw you?

people.line: …thirty-nine, forty. Can’t stop. Break the gear up the ladder?
people.lineDone: Forty-one. Then I sat. My choice.

rooms.name: Chainwalk
rooms.hint: A lift holds at the top for a breath, then goes home
rooms.question: Two lifts, one above the other. How does the first one get you onto the second?

rooms.name: The Upper Chain
rooms.hint: Wait a beat after a lift stops and it lets you go without a throw
rooms.question: Three lifts, and one of them throws you at the thorns. Which of them do you leave gently?

rooms.name: Counterweight Rise
rooms.hint: Dash into a stone and it runs that way until something stops it
rooms.question: The wall has no foothold. What can you send there to be one?

rooms.name: The Weigh Well
rooms.hint: A stone goes the way you strike it, down as well as across
rooms.question: The counterweight stops up the well. Which face of it do you strike?

rooms.name: The Standard Road
rooms.hint: Everything the causeway has taught, in one stretch
rooms.question: A plug, a flat lift and a crystal. In what order, and with what still in hand?

rooms.name: Rise Gantry
rooms.hint: A stone stays where it stops, so choose the wall before you push
rooms.question: The counterweight sits on the lift’s car. Where should it end up?

rooms.name: Broken Standard
rooms.hint: The Brute commits to a charge and stops only when something stops it
rooms.question: The brace across the road won’t give for you. What would break it?

rooms.name: The Maintenance Ladder
rooms.hint: Thorns line the shaft · the brake is a stone, and a stone struck from below goes up
rooms.question: The hatch is jammed shut. Which lift puts you under it, and which one throws you into the thorns?

rooms.name: The Governor
rooms.hint: A crystal pays back a dash you have already spent
rooms.question: The gear sits on the high shelf. How many dashes does the climb take, and where is the second one?

rooms.name: Borrow Only Enough
rooms.hint: No dash · Hold Down to load; release and jump from the rising plate.
rooms.question: What part of the rise clears both the landing and the teeth?

rooms.name: Door Becomes Stair
rooms.hint: Strike the brass hub to turn the arm. A turn needs clear space.
rooms.question: The far pocket is low and the way home is high. Which shape can serve both journeys?

rooms.name: Let Him Clear the Causeway
rooms.hint: Let the Brute commit beneath a weight. Cross the upper causeway while he clears the brace below. The second weight ends the chase.
rooms.question: Can the same opponent open the road you need to bait his next charge?

rooms.name: Sentry’s Aqueduct
rooms.hint: Follow the water through the abandoned channels.

retiredRoomDetails.name: Drop Yard
retiredRoomDetails.evidence: One four-tile vertical lift rises eleven tiles beside a thorned far bank. The saved route includes a 56-frame idle ride and no blade interaction; Chainwake Camp already establishes weight-triggered lift travel, while The Hoist follows with its new momentum lesson.

retiredRoomDetails.name: The Counterweight
retiredRoomDetails.reason: Replaced by its native boss superroom

quest.doneLine: Forty-one. Forty-two. I’ve lost count. Good.
lines: Thirty-nine, forty. The governor at the top of the ladder turns me. Strike its bright tooth; anything else and you only bruise your arm.
Take the key from my back, would you? Hang it on the toll hook, at the top of the next climb. Where nobody can wind me.
hud: Hang the winding key on the toll hook
